# 248 Linux-kernel architecture audit: boundary, lifecycle, UAPI, and execution-domain lessons

One-line summary: Evidence-backed Linux-source comparison that preserves Engine V2's correct
realtime/core boundaries and briefs bounded interface-stability, C-ABI evolution, managed-resource,
protocol-schema, observation, and ownership/fault-injection successors.

**Authority: GitHub issue #248.** The issue body is the complete stateless research and decision
record: it pins the audited Linux and Engine commits, cites every adopted source lesson, distinguishes
preservation constraints from findings, identifies existing issue ownership, and gives each proposed
successor a smallest closable slice plus objective gates. Read `AGENTS.md` and then
`gh issue view 248 --repo misofm/engine-v2` before using it.

This pointer authorizes no production-code change and no cross-cutting implementation branch. A
successor must receive its own Sol-approved stateless brief before Terra implementation and Sol
adversarial review. Do not reopen accepted render-plan exchange, host-core, BTLV, effect-contract, or
native-source-worker decisions, and do not duplicate the existing #124, #130, #163, #203, or
#239–#246 scopes.
